name: Accordion
description: Sections that open in place, divided by hairlines or set apart as cards.

props.name: variant
props.description: Flush divides rows with hairlines. Separated gives each row its own card.

props.name: allowsMultipleExpanded
props.description: Let more than one section stay open.

props.name: expandedKeys
props.description: The ids of the open sections (controlled).

props.name: defaultExpandedKeys
props.description: The ids of the sections open at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called when a section opens or closes.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components DisclosureGroup.

props.name: title
props.description: The row's heading. The whole row is the toggle.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the title, to fit the page outline.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Disclosure.
